summary.caption: Surreal widescreen architectural artwork at golden hour, a monumental brutalist cultural centre whose inhabited concrete structure is physically formed by giant letter shapes, warm sandstone, cobalt shadows, tiny visitors and precise editorial photography.

items.label: text
items.caption: The exact word rendered as colossal three-dimensional inhabited concrete architecture across the centre, with windows, stairs and people built into the letterforms.

items.label: object
items.caption: A long shallow reflecting pool beneath the letter-building, mirroring the monumental typography and golden sky with slight ripples.

items.label: character
items.caption: A small group of visitors in vivid cobalt clothing walking through the lower openings of the giant letters, clearly establishing scale.

items.label: text
items.caption: Small charcoal architectural caption in the upper-left sky.
